title: Ender Vision
description: This mod adds an item to the game that allows you to look at Endermans
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e4912aa02a27be4b9cfb3d8fab06e294ca2c3c5.png)

**Ender Vision** -  is a **Vanilla-like** mod that adds a balanced item to the game - Ender Goggles, which allow the player to see Endermen while sacrificing one armor slot.

This item will break by 1 durability point every minute while the player is wearing it. To repair it, take an Eye of Ender and right-click on the Ender Goggles in your inventory.

**This mod also supports multiple languages.  **
